core_obligations: Apply ZMT to U -> Spec(A) to get a quasi-affine hull; base change the decomposition to the closed subscheme Z = Spec(A/I), where U_fin -> Z is finite and closed, U_away -> Z is open with no points over Z.
Use the henselian-pair decomposition lemma (More on Algebra) to split U into a closed part U_fin finite over Spec(A) and an open part U_away disjoint from Z.
Conclude with the closed-points argument that U_away has no points lying over Z.
